resources.string: Gesture mouse for XREAL + external display
Connect the glasses and accept both USB permission prompts as quickly as possible — the handshake times out if it takes too long.
Accessibility service (external display cursor): inactive — enable it below

One-time setup — tap \"Grant permissions\" repeatedly (it takes 3-4 taps) until it stops asking for anything, then connect the glasses. After that, the app remembers everything and reconnects automatically.
Permissions OK — ready to connect the glasses
1. Tap \"Open Accessibility Settings\" below\n2. Find \"Hand Mouse\" in the list\n3. Enable it and confirm

Pinch (thumb + index) — tap to click, hold + move to drag
Open palm + swipe — media control (left/right = seek, up/down = volume); cursor freezes
Closed fist, hold 2s — recenter cursor
Thumbs up, hold 1s — hide/show cursor
V sign, hold 0.5s — start voice command listening

Back / Voltar — go back
Home / Início / Close / Fechar — go to home screen
Recents / Recentes — open recent apps
Send / Enviar — press Enter
Clear / Apagar tudo — clear text
Open <app name> / Abrir <nome do app> — launch an app
Write <text> / Escrever <texto> — dictate text
